text:
Application Delivery Platform Architecture

Diagram
flowchart LR
  DEV[Delivery Teams] --> PLAN[Planning and Requirements]
  PLAN --> SCM[Source and Artifact Management]
  SCM --> CICD[CI/CD Orchestration]

  CICD --> BUILD[Build and Packaging]
  CICD --> TEST[Automated Testing]
  CICD --> SCAN[Security and Compliance Scanning]
  BUILD --> REG[Artifact and Container Registry]
  TEST --> GATE[Quality and Approval Gates]
  SCAN --> GATE
  REG --> GATE

  GATE --> CONFIG[Configuration and Secrets]
  GATE --> DEPLOY[Deployment and Release Management]
  CONFIG --> DEPLOY
  DEPLOY --> RUNTIME[Application Runtime]
  DEPLOY --> INTEG[API and Integration Runtime]
  DEPLOY --> DATA[Databases and Data Services]

  USERS[Users and External Systems] --> EDGE[DNS, CDN, Load Balancing and API Gateway]
  EDGE --> RUNTIME
  EDGE --> INTEG
  RUNTIME <--> INTEG
  RUNTIME <--> DATA
  INTEG <--> DATA

  IAM[Identity and Access Management] --> CICD
  IAM --> EDGE
  IAM --> RUNTIME
  POLICY[Governance and Policy Management] --> GATE
  POLICY --> DEPLOY
  POLICY --> RUNTIME

  RUNTIME --> OBS[Logs, Metrics and Traces]
  INTEG --> OBS
  DATA --> OBS
  OBS --> OPS[Monitoring, Alerting and Incident Management]
  OPS --> PLAN
  OPS --> CICD
limitations: The platform is unspecified, so the diagram uses platform-neutral component categories rather than product-specific services.
